recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized portrait of a female artist set against a vibrant purple and blue gradient background, featuring a mix of large, expressive script lettering and wide, modern sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large script elements framing the central portrait
High-contrast lighting on the subject against a saturated background
Horizontal text blocks balancing the verticality of the script
Cool-toned color palette with deep purples and bright cyan highlights
coreInvariants: Combination of gestural script and wide sans-serif fonts
Subject centered with a hand-to-face pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up portrait, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, highlighted with high-key white tones.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script at the top, moves down to the face, and follows the body line to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep purple areas in the upper corners and cyan glow at the bottom.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with extreme value contrast in the subject's skin and clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended Geometric Sans and Gestural Script
letterConstructionRules: Display script uses thick-to-thin brush-like strokes with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses extremely wide, low-profile geometric characters
Uniform stroke weight in the sans-serif elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'e' in the script has a large, sweeping loop
The 'n' and 'u' in the sans-serif are nearly square in proportion

composition.overlap: behind and in front of subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, large-scale script and rigid, small-scale extended sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Soft cyan radial glow at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric 90s tech-inspired look of the secondary text.
The display text is highly gestural and likely custom-drawn.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a woman in a dark textured top, posed with hand to chin. The background should be a saturated purple gradient with a bright cyan glow at the bottom. Apply a slight film grain and high-key lighting to the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, semi-transparent white gestural script in the top third, framing the head. Add a small, white, extra-extended sans-serif title in the bottom right corner using lowercase letters.

verificationChecks: Is the purple background sufficiently saturated?
Is the secondary text extremely wide and lowercase?
Does the script lettering overlap the subject naturally?
Is the facial lighting high-contrast (blown out highlights)?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced use of wide and script typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script doesn't obscure the eyes.
Check that the cyan glow doesn't wash out the bottom text.
Verify the '90s grain' texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the purple hue is royal/deep rather than lavender.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast portraiture + saturated purple/cyan gradients + wide geometric sans-serif + expressive display script.
